title: 7. Application Endpoints
description: API reference and interactive guide for OData V4 catalog, orders, and AI chat endpoints.
content:
Complete Endpoint Catalog

System & Health Probes

MethodPathDescriptionResponse Example
GET<code>/healthz</code>CAP Server & Memory Health Probe<code>{"status":"OK"}</code>
GET<code>/readyz</code>Stdin/Stdout IPC Channel & Python Worker Probe<code>{"status":"READY","python":"OK"}</code>

OData V4 CatalogService (/browse)

MethodPathDescriptionAuth Required
GET<code>/browse/Books</code>List all catalog books with authors & stockOptional
GET<code>/browse/Authors</code>List all authorsOptional
GET<code>/browse/Orders</code>List user order historyYes
POST<code>/browse/Orders</code>Place a new orderYes
GET<code>/browse/discount(title='The%20Bestseller')</code>ML Python discount calculation functionOptional

Enterprise GenAI Endpoints (/ai)

MethodPathDescriptionPayload Parameters
POST<code>/ai/ask</code>Single-turn LLM completion<code>{"prompt":"...", "model":"..."}</code>
POST<code>/ai/ask_rag</code>SAP HANA Cloud REAL_VECTOR RAG search<code>{"prompt":"...", "model":"..."}</code>
POST<code>/ai/ask_agent</code>Stateful LangGraph Agentic workflow<code>{"prompt":"...", "model":"..."}</code>
POST<code>/ai/ask/stream</code>Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming<code>{"prompt":"...", "model":"..."}</code>

4-Destination Model Selection Examples

1. Priority 1 Primary (google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it)


POST /ai/ask
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "What are the core concepts of software architecture?",
  "model": "google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it"
}

2. Priority 2 (google/gemma-4-31b-it)


POST /ai/ask
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "Explain the difference between microservices and monoliths.",
  "model": "google/gemma-4-31b-it"
}

3. Priority 3 (z-ai/glm-5.2)


POST /ai/ask
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "Summarize the benefits of cloud native applications.",
  "model": "z-ai/glm-5.2"
}

4. Priority 4 Fallback (mistralai/mistral-nemotron)


POST /ai/ask
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "Recommend top 2 technology books and explain why.",
  "model": "mistralai/mistral-nemotron"
}

SAP HANA Cloud Vector RAG Request

POST /ai/ask_rag
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "Which bestseller books are available in stock with fantasy themes?",
  "model": "google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it"
}

Stateful LangGraph Agent Request

POST /ai/ask_agent
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "What is the discounted price for classic books?",
  "model": "google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it"
}

Rate Limiting & Security Headers

  • Sliding Window Rate Limiter: Enforces 15 req/min per client IP. Returns HTTP 429 upon abuse.

  • Security Headers: Helmet & CORS configured for cross-origin protection.
